controlling_assumptions: PR-289 performs identity admission only: no acquisition, feature extraction, likelihood evaluation, posterior inference, or scientific execution.
release-native or product-native means native to an external data release and never means a native BASS/native low-ell solver output.

A cross-record relationship is admissible only when its endpoints are exact factory-built DataIdentityRecordV2 record IDs and the relationship payload is itself content-addressed and included in the lane bundle identity.
The exact Planck, CF4, HSC, and KiDS convention values must come from authoritative release evidence; this audit specifies required typed roles and algebraic consistency, not invented values.

conventions.units: explicit typed input/output units; no implicit natural units or bare lane string
conventions.frames: component-level sky/data frame plus transform identity; equality only where a declared relation requires it
conventions.signs: component-level observable orientation and handedness; covariance axes inherit the corresponding observable sign/order contract
conventions.harmonics: Planck and spin-2 identities must bind coordinate, pixelization, ordering, harmonic, and polarization/axis conventions without executing transforms
conventions.depth: CF4 depth definition is an exact child identity and is not inferred from a generic selection_id

required: Planck map units and covariance product units; dimensionless beam, mask, and window; explicit HEALPix NSIDE/order/frame and harmonic convention.
CF4 catalogue column units including distance/h scaling and radial-velocity units; covariance units equal the ordered outer product of data-vector units; explicit radial sign and frame transform.
HSC/KiDS shear, PSF, n(z), calibration, response, and covariance axis/unit conventions per survey; cross-covariance units and order equal the HSC-by-KiDS product domains.
units_and_signs.nonclaim: Identity compatibility is not numerical normalization, PSD, calibration, or physical validation.

priors.rule: No prior family, hyperprior, or prior sensitivity result may be inferred from a release-native identity, covariance record, lane admission, or authorization receipt.

likelihood_semantics.rule: A covariance child identity binds bytes, axes, units, and applicable data records only. It does not select a Gaussian likelihood, validate covariance estimation, produce evidence, or authorize HTT inference. Deterministic operator/template identity remains distinct from stochastic covariance identity.

x_q_pi_f_g.rule: PR-289 admission must not emit or promote x_C, Q, Pi, certified F, or G_F. If downstream produced later, x_C remains signed, Q policy-normalized, Pi exceedance rather than truth probability, F certified occupancy, and G_F a null-calibrated depth-gap diagnostic.

local_global_rank.rule: PR-289 contains no covariance-whitened local/global response design. Shape, axis-order, operator, or covariance identity does not establish numerical rank, principal-angle separation, nuisance identifiability, or a global-tilt candidate. Downstream rank must fail closed before posterior inference.

family_identification.rule: Planck/CF4/HSC/KiDS release-native identities are observed-product provenance, not native solver transfer or a morphology atlas. They cannot support Bianchi geometry detection, family ranking, or family identification; scalar/directional/MIO diagnostics cannot upgrade the gate.

minimal_schema_contract.scope: Extend only the existing LANE_REGISTRY_V2.json plus common.data_identity v2 factory/evidence/decision path; do not create a separate identity framework.

required_children: component_roles: exact component_id to typed release-native role mapping
relationship_rules: exact kind, endpoint roles, cardinality, equality/difference constraints, and required status
parse_rules: Unknown role, relationship kind, endpoint, duplicate role, missing endpoint, self-link where distinct endpoints are required, or extra field fails registry load.
Every required component instance has exactly one release-native role; every required relationship has exactly one declaration.
Use release_native or product_native vocabulary; reject native_solver/native_atlas labels in this data-admission schema.

fields: component_bindings keyed by exact component_id, each with release_native_role, semantic_profile payload, semantic_profile_id, units/frame/sign/direction/harmonic/sky/selection/covariance/null identities as applicable
relationship_declarations keyed by registered relationship_id seed, referencing component_id endpoints and exact constraint payloads
content_addressing: semantic_profile_id is SHA-256 of the full finite component semantic payload, not a caller string
source_locator_identity binds the component bindings and relationship declarations as well as release/license and component inventory
DataIdentityRecordV2 stable payload includes release_native_role and semantic_profile_id
After child records are built, resolve each relationship endpoint to the exact record_id and factory-build a content-addressed relationship record
lane_admission_bundle_id binds ordered record_ids plus ordered relationship_ids; record counts alone are insufficient

relationship_record.rule: Factory-only and hash-sealed exactly like DataIdentityRecordV2. No relationship status expresses scientific validity, execution authorization, rank, likelihood, or family evidence.

required_relationships.constraint: distinct release-native roles and distinct record_ids; neither label may be inferred from filename or record order
both map profiles resolve to the identical sky selection, HEALPix NSIDE/order/frame, mask/support, pixel window, harmonic convention, and output support identities
operator input/output role, units, frame, harmonic domain, l-range/window, and exact child identities agree
operator input/output role, units, frame, harmonic domain, l-range/window, and exact child identities agree
REGISTERED requires an exact FFP10 inventory and operator profile; UNAVAILABLE_DECLARED requires a content-bound unavailability receipt and forbids a fabricated null ID
same observation/null selection, pixelization, mask, window, harmonic, and output axes for Commander
exact ordered pair output axes, support, units-product, and selection profile are bound; covariance identity does not imply likelihood validity
selection binds the exact catalogue record plus row-key namespace/order and no filename-only or release-name-only substitution
group keys, grouping algorithm/version, and selected row identity are explicit
depth variable, bin edges/inclusion rule, units, and ordered selected/grouped row domain are content-bound
ZoA mask/selection boundary, sky frame, inclusion orientation, and support identity agree
sky/velocity frame, radial positive direction, distance/h scaling, velocity units, column roles, and any transform identity are explicit; generic nonempty IDs fail

covariance binds exact selected ordered data-vector axes; each covariance unit is the outer product of corresponding observable units; shape/order identity alone is not PSD, rank, or likelihood validation
every HSC child resolves to the exact HSC release/product, selection/tomographic axes, shear/PSF sign convention, and units profile
every KiDS child resolves to the exact KiDS release/product, selection/tomographic axes, shear/PSF sign convention, and units profile
HSC and KiDS child record IDs and roles remain separate; byte equality, generic role aliasing, or list order cannot merge survey identities
calibration and response are separate exact children and bind the corrected HSC vector/order without asserting numerical calibration
calibration and response are separate exact children and bind the corrected KiDS vector/order without asserting numerical calibration
exact HSC corrected data-vector axes/order/units and no KiDS alias
exact KiDS corrected data-vector axes/order/units and no HSC alias

distinct cross-covariance child references both ordered corrected survey vectors, with HSC-by-KiDS axis orientation and product units; it cannot be inferred from either auto-covariance or a generic covariance ID

minimal_test_matrix.case: Each of PLANCK, CF4, and HSC_KIDS loads an exact registered release_native_profile; all component roles and relationship kinds resolve once; independently recomputed relationship_ids and lane bundle ID match.
The old _base_evidence generic strings and correct component record count are rejected as REJECTED_MISSING_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT; this is the direct regression lock for the reproduced defect.
A complete-looking list of valid record_ids with absent, dangling, reordered, or wrong-kind relationship records cannot create lane_admission_bundle_id.
Distinct SMICA and Commander maps admit only with the complete common-sky, observation-operator, matched-FFP10/null, and pair-covariance graph.
One map record used for both SMICA and Commander, filename-derived labels, swapped roles, or duplicate native roles fail.
A claimed same-sky pair with any mask, sky support, selection, coordinate frame, NSIDE/order, pixel window, or harmonic convention mismatch fails.
Missing/dangling/wrong-map beam, observation operator, window, l-domain, input/output unit, or output-axis relation fails.
REGISTERED FFP10 status without exact inventory and per-profile null operators, observation/null profile mismatch, or UNAVAILABLE_DECLARED with fabricated null ID fails.
Exact catalogue, row selection, covariance, frame, radial sign, units, grouping, depth, and ZoA children admit with all relation endpoints resolved.
Selection bound to a different catalogue/release, missing row-key order, generic selection string, or name-only catalogue fails.
Generic frame/sign/units text, opposite radial sign, incompatible frame transform, ambiguous h scaling, or covariance units inconsistent with the data-vector outer product fails.
Missing grouping/depth/ZoA child, wrong selected-row endpoint, incompatible sky frame, or mutated bin/inclusion boundary fails.
Covariance bound only by ID/count, to the unselected catalogue, or to a different row/depth/group/ZoA order fails; no test calls shape identity PSD/rank/likelihood validation.
Separate HSC and KiDS products each have exact mask/random/PSF/n(z)/calibration/response/auto-covariance children, plus one exact cross-covariance relation spanning both corrected ordered vectors.
Singleton shared psf, n_z, shear_calibration, response, or covariance role cannot satisfy both surveys; HSC/KiDS role aliasing or list-order inference fails.
Any child bound to the wrong survey release/product, mask, tomography selection/order, or shear/PSF convention fails.
Calibration substituted for response, missing either child, or either applying to a different selected/tomographic vector fails.
Cross-covariance absent, aliased to an auto-covariance, referencing only one survey, reversed without explicit orientation, or mismatched in axes/order/units fails.

A fully related lane remains ADMITTED_IDENTITY_ONLY with NOT_AUTHORIZED receipt, diagnostic_only claim tier, observed_data_executed=false, transfer_source=none, family gate blocked, and no prior/likelihood/Q/F/G/rank fields.

Relationship completeness cannot emit AUTHORIZED, observed, native_solver, likelihood, posterior, evidence, full-rank, global-tilt, morphology-family, or family-identification status; mutation validation must kill every such promotion.
